name: Ordinary Matter — Editorial Publication
description: A quiet, cream-paper editorial site for Ordinary Matter, a publication about people who make things by hand: a split home page with a pinned, auto-dissolving portrait column beside scrolling dispatches; a cloth-bound volume on a timber table whose cover opens as you scroll and whose pages really turn; a pinned four-step story of how a book gets made in oversized serif; a loud index of makers with a photo that follows the cursor; a postcard that writes itself as you sign up; and drawn, draggable product mockups with a working bag and checkout — plus Stories, Shop and About pages and a live brand guide.
designedFor: Magazines, journals, books and independent publishers
Editorial, craft, interiors and lifestyle brands with long-form stories
Shops selling a few considered objects, shown as working mockups rather than photos
Seeing sticky, scroll-scrubbed scenes and interactive mockups built as editor-controllable components
